task-intent.statement: Apply the bounded Codex-tier launcher changes inside the repo-local delegated worktree.

expected-behavior.statement: The edit path would patch files in the writable repo-local Codex worktree on its first attempt.

observed-behavior.statement: The initial worktree edit attempt failed before applying content with bwrap reporting RTM_NEWADDR was not permitted; a fresh TTY attempt later applied the edit successfully in the same worktree.

impact-cost.statement: The implementation needed an extra launch attempt and explicit confirmation that the failed attempt had not partially edited the scoped files.

workaround.statement: The run retried the same bounded edit from a fresh TTY and then verified the resulting diff and focused tests.

task-intent.statement: Independently verify that checked-in tests proved every required reasoning-effort persistence and recovery boundary.

expected-behavior.statement: Approval would be supported by direct checked-in coverage of parser-to-external registry persistence, abandon/relaunch inheritance, legacy omission, and unchanged Claude argv.

observed-behavior.statement: The initial reviewer approved while explicitly noting that parser-to-external persistence and relaunch inheritance were not directly asserted by checked-in tests; Admiral adjudication reopened execution, and the resulting rework added those tests before a fresh reviewer approved.

impact-cost.statement: The evidence gap required one bounded implementation rework and a second independent review even though the original focused launcher tests were green.

workaround.statement: The rework replaced temporary-review evidence with direct RC.main registry and relaunch tests, and the fresh review traced those tests to production paths and reran all 166 launcher tests.

task-intent.statement: Verify the bounded launcher change on Linux with both focused coverage and the repository-wide suite.

expected-behavior.statement: The focused launcher suite and the full Linux suite would both remain green after the metadata-only change.

observed-behavior.statement: The focused launcher suite passed, while the full Linux suite reported two failures in unrelated baseline areas: generated map freshness and an inspect-source assertion.

impact-cost.statement: The two full-suite failures required comparison against the unchanged baseline and scoped diff before execution could be closed without expanding this launcher task.

workaround.statement: The run recorded both failures as pre-existing out-of-scope baseline evidence and relied on the green complete launcher module plus direct diff review for the scoped change.
